audioText: Mercenary with a thick Scottish accent. Impatient, angry, traditional, gruff, battle-hardened, stony delivery. Rough, textured, gravelly voice.<speak>She's... eccentric, some say, but her knowledge of ancient dwarven smithing techniques is reputed to be unparalleled. She's been petitioning me for resources to investigate Varnok's Forge. Varnok was a recluse, an artisan of mind-bending skill who delved into enchantments and possibly even elemental manipulation in his work.</speak>
